classification.difficultyReason: Rearrange each equation, identify an exact acute reference angle and use the ratio's sign to find both solutions in the specified domain.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}2\sin\theta-1&=0\\2\sin\theta&=1\\\sin\theta&=\frac12\\A&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac12\right)=30^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
Sine is positive in Q1 and Q2.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=30^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad180^{\circ}-30^{\circ}\\\theta&=30^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad150^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\sqrt2\cos\theta-1&=0\\\sqrt2\cos\theta&=1\\\cos\theta&=\frac1{\sqrt2}\\A&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac1{\sqrt2}\right)=45^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
Cosine is positive in Q1 and Q4.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=45^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad360^{\circ}-45^{\circ}\\\theta&=45^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad315^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\sqrt3\tan\theta-2&=-1\\\sqrt3\tan\theta&=1\\\tan\theta&=\frac1{\sqrt3}\\A&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac1{\sqrt3}\right)=30^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
Tangent is positive in Q1 and Q3.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=30^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad180^{\circ}+30^{\circ}\\\theta&=30^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad210^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}2\cos\theta+\sqrt3&=0\\2\cos\theta&=-\sqrt3\\\cos\theta&=-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\A&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)=30^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
Cosine is negative in Q2 and Q3.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}-30^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad180^{\circ}+30^{\circ}\\\theta&=150^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad210^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}6\sin\theta+3&=0\\6\sin\theta&=-3\\\sin\theta&=-\frac12\\A&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac12\right)=30^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
Sine is negative in Q3 and Q4.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}+30^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad360^{\circ}-30^{\circ}\\\theta&=210^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad330^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}1+\tan\theta&=0\\\tan\theta&=-1\\A&=\tan^{-1}(1)=45^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
Tangent is negative in Q2 and Q4.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}-45^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad360^{\circ}-45^{\circ}\\\theta&=135^{\circ}\quad\text{or}\quad315^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
